name: Heritage Walnut Coffee Table
description: Low-slung walnut coffee table with softly rounded corners and four splayed, tapered solid-walnut legs. Mid-century modern in proportion with a rich, warm grain.

name: Savile Walnut Coffee Table
description: Walnut coffee table with brass inlay detailing along the top edges, a slatted walnut magazine shelf beneath, and tapered legs finished with polished brass sabots. Luxe mid-century styling, retail-grade catalogue piece.

name: Petal Boucle Accent Chair
description: Low-profile mid-century boucle wingback accent chair in textured ivory boucle, seated on four splayed solid walnut legs. Compact, sculptural occasional seating for lounges, reading corners and bedrooms.

name: Contour Lounge Chair
description: Contemporary lounge chair with a curved bent-ply natural birch frame and generous olive-green upholstered seat and back cushions. Sculptural, light and modern with a warm organic palette.

name: Musu Stoneware Bowls
description: Nested set of four hand-thrown stoneware bowls in a speckled oatmeal glaze with exposed sandy foot rings. Artisanal, imperfect forms for everyday serving and prep.

name: Woven Dusk Throw
description: Chunky waffle-knit throw blanket in soft cream cotton with a loose, tactile weave. Casual neutral layering piece for sofas and beds in Japandi, coastal and farmhouse schemes.
